name: ASC

readme_excerpt: Droid ASC: R8 Compiler Optimization as a DeCompiler Primitive https://blackhat.com/europe/arsenal/schedule/index.html#droid-asc-r8-compiler-optimization-as-a-decompiler-primitive-54834 When decompiling massive Android APKs, the standard procedure is to wait. We wait for tools to eat gigabytes of RAM, fully inflate the artifacts, and spend tens of minutes building heavy global indexes and cross references... All of this is just to guarantee fast code searches later, but here is the contradiction…
